Following an introduction at the 2015 Frankfurt Motor Show, the 991 received a mid-cycle facelift for the 2016 model year. The updated Porsche 911 (at Porsche internally referred to as 991.2 or 991 II) introduced new styling including updated front and rear bumpers, new dual exhaust pipes along with new head and tail lights and options, along with all new, 3.0-litre twin-turbocharged flat-six engines across the range. This marked the first time the base 911 models had turbocharged engines.

Initially from October 2015, available models were the coupé and cabriolet versions of Carrera and Carrera S.

The all-wheel drive versions Carrera 4 and 4S were unveiled in December 2015.

In 2016, Porsche unveiled 911 Carrera S Endurance Racing Edition to celebrate manufacturer's 18th win in Le Mans. The body could be done in White or Red, with black decals on sides, hood, roof and rear spoiler. Also car gets Sport exhaust system as standard. 235 cars were built.

In September 2018 Porsche decided to celebrate 15th anniversary of Carrera Cup Asia with 911 Carrera 15 Years Carrera Cup Asia Edition. It was based on base Carrera and was available in 2 colors - red and white. The car also had Carrera S rims and Sport exhaust system as standard and black decals on hood, roof, rear spoilers and sides. Porsche does not specify how many units were made.

description:
This 2004 Chevrolet Corvette Base is a two-seat sports car with a low-slung profile and an aluminum-framed body that reflects the model's focus on weight control and performance. This generation uses rear-wheel drive and a front-engine layout, paired with a 5.7-liter V8 and a six-speed automatic transmission. The drivetrain is supported by an independent suspension arrangement at both ends, and the chassis was engineered to deliver direct steering response and balanced road manners. Its proportions are compact for the class, with long hood lines, short overhangs, and a wide stance that contribute to its familiar Corvette shape.

This exterior is finished with details that match the car's purpose without adding unnecessary ornamentation. This example includes fog lights, which are integrated into the front fascia, along with fixed rear bodywork that keeps the styling clean and simple. The removable roof panel is part of the Corvette's design and allows the cabin to be opened to the elements when desired. Flush door handles, curved glass, and a low beltline are all part of the body design, and the overall appearance remains consistent with the C5 generation introduced in the late 1990s. The underbody and aero features were shaped to work with the car's performance-oriented engineering rather than to add visual complexity.

This interior is trimmed with leather seats, and the cabin follows a two-passenger format with a driver-focused instrument panel. This model includes automatic climate control, which is integrated into the center stack alongside the other cabin controls. The seating position is low, with a wide center console separating the occupants and a broad dashboard carrying the main gauges in front of the driver. Materials and switchgear are arranged in a way that reflects the Corvette's premium sports-car positioning within Chevrolet's lineup, while still keeping the environment straightforward and functional. Storage space is limited, as expected in a car of this type, and the cockpit is arranged around access to the controls rather than extra room.

This Corvette also includes premium audio and keyless entry among its equipment. The audio system is built into the center of the dash and is intended to provide a higher level of sound equipment than the most basic setup. Keyless entry is included for access convenience, and the controls are integrated into the vehicle's electronic systems. This 2004 Chevrolet Corvette Base uses a combination of mechanical and electronic features that were standard for the era, including stability-related chassis design and a transmission that can be shifted automatically. The car's specifications place it among the more capable American performance cars of its time, with a V8 powertrain, two-seat cabin, and a body structure developed around driving dynamics rather than utility.

description:
Introducing the 2020 Ford F-550 Super Duty, a heavy-duty commercial service truck equipped with a Liftmoore hydraulic crane, Vanair Air N Arc 300 Diesel all-in-one power system, and a fully compartmentalized mechanic's service body. Designed for demanding field service applications, this F-550 combines lifting capability, welding, compressed air, electrical power, and extensive tool storage into one versatile mobile workstation.

One of the highlights of this truck is its Liftmoore 6036-series hydraulic service crane, featuring a telescoping boom, hydraulic rotation, powered boom elevation and extension, and an integrated winch system. The crane is equipped with a 6,000-pound-rated hook block and provides valuable lifting capability for handling heavy components, machinery, engines, and equipment in the field. Actual lifting capacity varies depending on boom position, extension, and the manufacturer's load chart.

Another major feature is the Vanair Air N Arc 300 Diesel, a self-contained combination welding, air compressor, generator, and battery service system powered by an independent Kubota diesel engine. This system provides up to 300 amps of DC welding output, a 7,000-watt generator, and a 40 CFM rotary screw air compressor capable of producing up to 175 PSI. It also includes 12/24-volt battery boosting and 12-volt battery charging capabilities. With its independent diesel power source, the Vanair system allows technicians to operate essential tools and equipment at remote job sites without relying on the truck's engine.

The heavy-duty mechanic's service body offers numerous exterior storage compartments designed to keep tools, replacement parts, and service equipment organized and accessible. Additional equipment includes multiple retractable hose reels, a rear-mounted Wilton bench vise, diamond-plate work surfaces, a heavy-duty rear work platform, and stabilizer equipment to support lifting and field service operations.

The Ford F-550 Super Duty chassis provides a substantial foundation for this specialized equipment package, with heavy-duty construction designed to handle demanding commercial applications. The extended cab configuration offers additional interior room for crew members, tools, and work-related essentials, making it a practical choice for businesses that need a fully equipped mobile service vehicle.

This F-550 is well suited for mobile diesel mechanics, heavy-equipment repair, agricultural equipment service, construction companies, fleet maintenance operations, and industrial service businesses. Its combination of hydraulic lifting capability, independent diesel-powered welding and compressed-air equipment, onboard electrical generation, and extensive tool storage makes it a comprehensive mobile repair and maintenance platform.

With its Liftmoore hydraulic crane, Vanair Air N Arc 300 Diesel system, fully compartmentalized service body, retractable hose reels, rear work platform, and heavy-duty Ford F-550 chassis, this 2020 Ford F-550 Super Duty offers an impressive combination of equipment and capability for professional field service operations.

The 2020 Ford F-550 Super Duty Service Truck is available now at Independent Auto Sales, 1280 S Market St, Troy, Ohio 45373. Call (937) 335-4878 or visit www.independentautosales.com for more details.

Whether you're a contractor, delivery driver, or small business owner, this cargo van checks the boxes that matter most.About This 2017 Ford Transit 250 Cargo VanThis 2017 Ford Transit 250 comes equipped with the practical Low Roof body style paired with a 60/40 side door and a rear wheel base (RWB) configuration — a combination that balances cargo volume with ease of access in tight loading zones. At 115,181 miles, this van is well into its working life but still has plenty to offer. The Ford Transit platform is engineered for high mileage, and when properly maintained, these vans routinely push well past 200,000 miles in commercial service. For any buyer in Bakersfield or the greater Kern County area looking for a used work van that's ready to earn its keep, this is a smart entry point.

The low-roof design makes it easier to drive through standard parking structures and residential areas, while the extended wheelbase opens up a generous cargo bay that can accommodate shelving, equipment racks, or large pallets depending on your trade.2017 Ford Transit 250 Performance and EngineUnder the hood, this Transit 250 is powered by a 3.7-liter V6 flex-fuel engine paired with a smooth 6-speed overdrive SelectShift automatic transmission. The flex-fuel capability means this van can run on standard gasoline or E85 ethanol blends — giving business owners flexibility at the pump depending on local fuel availability and pricing.

The rear-wheel-drive configuration is well-suited for a cargo van carrying variable loads, providing predictable handling under weight. The SelectShift transmission allows the driver to manually select gears when needed, which is particularly useful when navigating mountain grades on Highway 58 or Tehachapi Pass — routes that Kern County drivers know well. The V6 delivers solid pulling power without the added complexity and cost of a diesel powertrain, making maintenance more straightforward for most small fleet operators.Ford Transit 250 Features and InteriorAs a cargo van, the Transit 250 is purpose-built rather than comfort-focused — but that doesn't mean it's spartan behind the wheel. The driver's cab is well-organized, with clear sight lines and an ergonomic layout that reduces fatigue on long routes.

Cargo Configuration

The 60/40 passenger-side sliding door is one of this van's most practical assets, allowing loading from the curb while keeping the larger panel accessible for bulkier items. The low-roof interior provides ample standing room for most workers while keeping overall vehicle height manageable for clearance-restricted areas. The rear cargo area is open and unfinished from the factory, giving new owners a blank canvas to build out for their specific trade — whether that's plumbing, electrical, HVAC, courier work, or mobile service operations.

Driver's Cab

The cab includes Ford's driver-forward seating position, which gives excellent visibility and a command feel that makes maneuvering in urban environments easier than with traditional full-size vans. Standard amenities typically include power windows, power locks, cruise control, and auxiliary input, keeping the driver connected and comfortable throughout long shifts.Ford Transit Reliability and OwnershipThe Ford Transit replaced the long-running E-Series as Ford's primary commercial van, and it quickly earned a strong reputation among fleet operators and small business owners alike. The 3.7-liter V6 engine in this generation of Transit is known for its durability and relatively low maintenance costs compared to EcoBoost turbocharged alternatives. While the EcoBoost engines offer more power, many high-mileage commercial buyers prefer the naturally aspirated 3.7 for its simplicity and proven track record.

Common maintenance items to stay on top of include brake service (these vans work hard), transmission fluid changes, and cooling system maintenance. At 115,000 miles, it's worth confirming that major scheduled services have been completed. Overall, Transit owners report high satisfaction with the platform's versatility, parts availability, and the wide network of Ford commercial service centers across the country — including right here in Kern County. When you're shopping for a work vehicle, buying locally matters — you want a dealer who understands what working Californians need and who stands behind the vehicles they sell.

At Prestige Auto Sales, the process is straightforward and pressure-free. The team understands that commercial vehicle buyers often have specific timelines and budget considerations, and they're equipped to work with you. The rear seat entertainment system keeps additional occupants engaged on longer journeys, and soft-closing doors throughout add a thoughtful touch to daily interactions with the vehicle.This Escalade V-Series stands ready to serve as your statement of success and capability, blending unmistakable presence with purposeful luxury. The combination of commanding performance, intelligent technology, and refined materials creates a vehicle that meets the demands of discerning owners who expect nothing less than excellence.

This Cadillac presents its hardware in a straightforward way, with the black exterior details and tinted windows working with the white paint for a more defined appearance.

The Federal Emissions Requirements option is listed on the vehicle, and the Front License Plate Bracket is present for states that require it. These items are part of the vehicle's equipment rather than cosmetic changes, and they add to the long list of factory and installed details already on the Escalade.

The leather upholstery and third-row seating provide the expected passenger space, while the panoramic roof brings additional light into the interior. The tinted glass and Onyx Package darken several exterior accents without affecting the underlying trim level or equipment list.
